            <div class="intro-text">
                <p>Hi! I'm Rob &mdash; a Staff Research Scientist and <a href="https://sakana.ai/seed-round/">Founding Member</a> at <a href="https://sakana.ai/">Sakana.AI</a><img src="/imgs/sakana-emoji-sm.png" class="sakana-emoji" alt="">, where we build nature-inspired methods for the LLM era. My work includes <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.06292">The AI Scientist</a> (<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.08066">v2</a>, <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18933">v3</a>), <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.19349">ShinkaEvolve</a>, <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.18381">EvoLLM</a>, and learned <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.11260">evolutionary</a> <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.03995">optimization</a>. I'm also wrapping up my PhD on Evolutionary Meta-Learning at TU Berlin. Before that, I spent time at Google DeepMind in Tokyo and interned with the London Discovery team.</p>
